description: Goals of all the trainer's students at once (same window as the app: ended at most 60 days ago or still running): student, student_phone (the guardian's for a dependent), goal title and type, progress_percent, current/target, end_date, status (done = reached, active = running, missed = deadline passed) and the app_url of the student profile. Reached goals come first (to congratulate), then running ones closest to the target, then missed ones. Use it for "who hit the goal?" or "who is close?"; for one student list_student_goals gives the detail. Read only: nothing changes and no message is sent.
name: list_student_goals_overview
title: See my students goals
